anya: quick alert 10% canary for v2024.11 showing tokenization regressions in ap-northeast. p95 +70ms and parse-error ~1.1% vs baseline 0.1%. Can we gate?

deploy-bot: deploy 1943210000 started by anya - canary -> 10%. 5/50 targets healthy. logs: tokenizer stream available.

leo: Looks like token-v2 landed without fallback enabled. I can push a config flip.

maria: release notes need a line about tokenizer fallback and known workaround. I'll patch the draft.

ops-runner: Proposal: hold at 10%, toggle `tokenizer.fallback=true` for rollout=canary, observe 10m. If error rate falls <0.3% continue ramp; else rollback to v2024.10.

anya: Go for the toggle. Who runs it?

deploy-bot: running: `rwctl config set tokenizer.fallback=true --selector rollout=canary`
deploy-bot: applied to 5/5 targets. status=ok.

ops-runner: 8m in: parse errors down to 0.2%, p95 back near baseline. Recommend bake for 12m then ramp to 25%.

release-manager: Vote check - :thumbsup: to proceed after bake, :thumbsdown: to keep hold or rollback.

anya: :thumbsup:

leo: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup: (notes updated)

ops-runner: :thumbsup: (monitoring)

deploy-bot: annotate rollout 1943210000: "fallback enabled, bake hold started"

release-manager: Consensus -> proceed after bake. Scheduling ramp to 25% at 1943210900 unless a hold is raised.
